description: This file contains utility functions for convolution operations, including padding calculations, gradient computations, and unfolding for 3D tensors, specifically tailored for convolutional neural network implementations in PyTorch.

methods.name: conv_picker
methods.description: Selects the appropriate convolution function based on the provided function (1D, 2D, or 3D).

methods.name: conv_args_and_kwargs
methods.description: Prepares convolution arguments and keyword arguments for normalization.

methods.name: conv_normalizer
methods.description: Normalizes convolution parameters into a tuple and dictionary for use in convolution operations.

methods.name: conv_input_for_string_padding
methods.description: Calculates input tensor with appropriate padding based on padding style ('valid' or 'same').

methods.name: int_padding_for_string_padding
methods.description: Calculates integer padding values for 'same' or 'valid' padding styles.

methods.name: conv_padding_for_same
methods.description: Computes padding values for 'same' padding style based on dilation and kernel size.

methods.name: conv_backward
methods.description: Performs backward pass for convolution, computing gradients with respect to input, weight, and bias.

methods.name: conv_unfold_weight_grad_sample
methods.description: Computes per-sample weight gradients for 3D convolution using unfolding.

methods.name: conv_group_weight_grad_sample
methods.description: Computes per-sample weight gradients for grouped convolution.

methods.name: unfold3d
methods.description: Extracts sliding local blocks from a 5D input tensor, similar to 2D unfold but for 3D data.
